choose.title: Parachute Cloud
choose.line: We run it. Sign up with your email; nothing to set up.

choose.title: Your own Cloudflare
choose.line: Cloud's code on an account you own. One owner, a Nostr key, about 15 minutes in a terminal; nothing to keep on.

choose.title: Your own computer
choose.line: One program on your Mac or Linux box. Everything on your disk, as many people as you add; the computer stays on.
